description: Claude usage widget for Windows 10 and 11: a small desktop widget that shows your Claude Code 5-hour limit and weekly limit with traffic-light bars and reset countdowns. Rate limit monitor in PowerShell, no install, no admin rights.
release_notes:
First public release of Claude Usage Widget, a desktop widget for Windows 10 and 11 that shows your Claude Code 5-hour and weekly usage limits.

- Two bars with percent used and a countdown to each reset (blue under 60%, amber from 60%, red from 85%).
- Signed-out state with one-click `claude auth login`.
- Slow, rate-limit-friendly polling with backoff.
- Reads the Claude Code login read-only and talks only to api.anthropic.com. Unofficial and not affiliated with Anthropic; the endpoint it reads is undocumented.

Install: unzip anywhere, run `install.bat`. Needs Claude Code signed in with a Pro or Max account.
